name: pptx
description: Generate editable PowerPoint (PPTX) decks from requirements, topics or provided text/Markdown. Pass params.mode='free_design' when the person asks, in any words or language, for no template, a different design or layout on every page, a bespoke or magazine-like look, or a reference deck to imitate; otherwise leave params.mode unset. Designed templates are the default (fast, for ordinary reports, proposals, training and pitches); free design designs every page individually and is slower.

examples: make powerpoint presentation about quarterly results
turn my notes into slide deck
